mapper.sql: t.id, t.store_id, t.tech_id, t.type, t.start_time, t.end_time, t.reason, t.status, t.audit_by, t.audit_time, t.create_time, t.update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ams_leave_request (store_id, tech_id, type, start_time, end_time, reason, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{techId}, #{type}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT , u.username as techName FROM ams_leave_request t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON t.tech_id = u.id WHERE t.id = #{id}
